name: MSPM0G3507_Q1
description: TI MSPM0G3507-Q1 Arm Cortex-M0+ automotive MCU (AEC-Q100 Grade 1, ISO 26262 ASIL B) with CAN-FD, 28-pin VSSOP (DGS28) -- orderable M0G3507QDGS28RQ1, 7.1 x 3 mm. Evaluation/candidate MCU per docs/security-mcu-comparison.md SS9.8; the project MCU of record is still the NXP S32K144 (symbols/specs/S32K144.json, REFERENCES.md [31]) -- adding this symbol does NOT change any build's MCU selection.
verification: VERIFIED (pin numbers) -- every physical pin number below is read directly from the local copy of [43] (TI MSPM0G3507-Q1/G3506-Q1/G3505-Q1 datasheet, SLASF88C, October 2023, revised September 2025, 126 pp.), '28 DGS28' column of Table 6-3 'Signal Descriptions' (pp. 17-25), cross-checked against the '28 VSSOP' column of Table 6-2 'Pin Attributes' (pp. 13-15) and against the package pin diagram, Figure 6-7 '28-Pin DGS28 (VSSOP) (Top View)' (p. 12). All three agree; the symbol carries all 28 physical pins, so it is a complete package-exact part, not a subset like the superseded 64-pin symbols/specs/MSPM0G3507.json ([1]) was. PACKAGE SELECTION RATIONALE (AGENTS.md SS4 judgment call, not a datasheet requirement): DGS28 is the smallest of the six packages this family ships in ([43] p.1 'Package options'; p.2-3 package-size table gives 28 VSSOP = 7.1 x 3 mm, versus 32 VSSOP 8.1 x 4.9 mm, 32 VQFN 5 x 5 mm, 48 VQFN 7 x 7 mm, 48 LQFP 9 x 9 mm, 64 LQFP 12 x 12 mm). It carries 24 GPIO ([43] Table 5-1, p.7) against the 21 signals this build's MCU role requires (see symbols/specs/S32K144.json for the same 21-signal role list: 2 CAN, 3 RS-485, 4 gate-driver SPI, 4 ADC, 6 PWM, 2 SWD), so DGS28 meets the requirement with 3 GPIO to spare and no larger package is needed. SIGNAL-TO-PIN ASSIGNMENT is likewise this build's own design decision among the IOMUX alternatives Table 6-2 lists for each pin (AGENTS.md SS4), NOT a datasheet-mandated mapping; each pin's 'mux' field below records the exact datasheet function name and PINCM function index [n] it relies on, so any reassignment can be re-checked against Table 6-2/6-3 directly. Three assignments are forced by the package, not chosen: CAN_TX and CAN_RX have exactly one DGS28 pin each (pins 1 and 2 -- PA12/PA13, which carry CAN on the larger packages, are not bonded out on DGS28), and SWDIO/SWCLK have exactly one pin each (22/23). CONSTRAINTS THIS ASSIGNMENT DELIBERATELY HONORS, each a judgment call: (a) all six PWM outputs come from advanced-control timer TIMA0 as three complementary pairs (C0/C0N, C1/C1N, C2/C2N), which is the only way to get the hardware dead-band insertion a 3-phase inverter half-bridge needs -- [43] SS8.22, p.63 area, lists 'Complementary output PWM' and 'Asymmetric PWM with programmable dead band insertion' for TIMA0/TIMA1; (b) the three phase-current inputs are split across both ADC instances (ADC_IU=A0_7 and ADC_IV=A0_3 on ADC0, ADC_IW=A1_0 on ADC1) so two conversions can run concurrently on the two 12-bit ADCs rather than serially on one -- whether that split is sufficient for this build's chosen control-loop topology is an open question, since the control axis is still unspecified (builds/6s/50A/CAN_485_faraday/README.md 'Open items'); (c) pin 13 (PA6) is left unassigned specifically because it is one of only two DGS28 pins that can carry TIMA_FAL0, the advanced timer's hardware fault-shutdown input (Table 6-3, p.24: TIMA_FAL0 DGS28 = pins 1, 13 -- and pin 1 is forced to CAN_TX), so wiring DRV8353S nFAULT to a hardware PWM-shutdown path remains physically possible on this package; that wiring is NOT decided here, because builds/6s/50A/CAN_485_faraday/kicad/README.md explicitly holds nFAULT open as an unresolved design question and assigning it in this symbol would resolve it by fiat; (d) pin 21 (PA18) is left unassigned because it is the ROM bootloader's hardware invoke pin (Table 6-3, p.17: BSL_invoke DGS28 = pin 21, sole location, not relocatable), so the BSL field-update entry path stays available. TRADE-OFF ACCEPTED, flagged rather than hidden: ADC_VBUS is assigned to pin 24, which is also VREF- (Table 6-3, p.25). Consuming VREF- rules out an external ADC voltage reference and commits the design to the internal shared reference ([43] p.1 'Features': 'Configurable 1.4V or 2.5V internal shared voltage reference (VREF)'; SS7.15/SS8.14). The alternative -- ADC_VBUS on pin 21 (A1_3), keeping VREF+/VREF- both free -- was rejected because it consumes the non-relocatable BSL_invoke pin, and because the INA240 current-sense outputs this ADC reads are ratiometric to their own supply and the VREF_MID bias rail, which favors a supply-referenced conversion over an absolute external reference. This is a one-line reversal in this file if the repo owner prefers the other side of the trade. NOT VERIFIED / NOT CLAIMED: the GPIO (plain digital I/O) PINCM function index is not enumerated in [43] -- Table 6-2 lists each pin's alternate functions starting at index [2] and footnote (1) states only that PF and PC are set to 0 for analog functions -- so RS485_DE_RE's 'mux' field below names the function without asserting an index; see [39] (SLAU846E) IOMUX chapter to pin that down. This datasheet also documents no hardware RS-485 driver-enable mode for any UART ([43] SS8.23 Table 8-15 'UART Features', p.69, lists LIN/DALI/IrDA/ISO7816/Manchester for UART0 only and no RS-485 entry for any instance), which is why RS485_DE_RE is a plain GPIO here rather than a hardware-driven DE -- the same treatment symbols/specs/S32K144.json gives it. Adopting this part into a build additionally requires a MSPM0-specific power/analog review that this symbol does not perform (VCORE decoupling, VREF decoupling per Table 6-3 footnote (3), and the unused-pin terminations in Table 6-4, p.25).

pins.name: VCORE
pins.mux: Regulated core power supply OUTPUT -- external decoupling cap only, do not drive (Table 6-3 'Power', p.21)

pins.name: NRST
pins.mux: Reset input, active low (Table 6-3 'System', p.23)

pins.name: SWDIO
pins.mux: SWDIO [2] on PA19 -- sole DGS28 location (Table 6-2 p.14; Table 6-3 'Debug' p.19)

pins.name: SWCLK
pins.mux: SWCLK [2] on PA20 -- sole DGS28 location (Table 6-2 p.14; Table 6-3 'Debug' p.19)

pins.name: CAN_TX
pins.mux: CAN_TX [6] on PA26 -- sole DGS28 location, PA12 not bonded out (Table 6-2 p.14; Table 6-3 'CAN' p.17)

pins.name: CAN_RX
pins.mux: CAN_RX [6] on PA27 -- sole DGS28 location, PA13 not bonded out (Table 6-2 p.14; Table 6-3 'CAN' p.17)

pins.name: RS485_TXD
pins.mux: UART3_TX [4] on PA14 (Table 6-2 p.14; Table 6-3 'UART' p.24)

pins.name: RS485_RXD

pins.name: RS485_DE_RE
pins.mux: Plain digital GPIO on PA17; no hardware RS-485 DE mode exists (Table 8-15 p.69) -- GPIO PINCM index not enumerated in [43], see verification field

pins.name: GD_SPI_CS
pins.mux: SPI0_CS0 [3] on PA2 -- sole DGS28 location (Table 6-2 p.13; Table 6-3 'SPI' p.21)

pins.name: GD_SPI_MISO
pins.mux: SPI0_POCI [3] on PA10 (Table 6-2 p.14; Table 6-3 'SPI' p.21)

pins.name: GD_SPI_MOSI
pins.mux: SPI0_PICO [3] on PA5 (Table 6-2 p.13; Table 6-3 'SPI' p.21)

pins.name: GD_SPI_SCK
pins.mux: SPI0_SCK [3] on PA11 (Table 6-2 p.14; Table 6-3 'SPI' p.21)

pins.name: PA6/TIMA_FAL0
pins.mux: SPARE, deliberately reserved -- one of only two DGS28 pins with TIMA_FAL0 [4] (advanced-timer hardware fault shutdown; other is pin 1, forced to CAN_TX). Also SPI0_SCK [3], TIMG0_C1 [5], HFCLK_IN [6]. Assignment NOT decided here, see verification field (c)

pins.name: PA18/BSL_INVOKE
pins.mux: SPARE, deliberately reserved -- ROM bootloader hardware invoke pin, sole DGS28 location, not relocatable (Table 6-3 'BSL' p.17). Also A1_3, SPI1_PICO [3], UART1_RX [2], TIMA0_C3N [5]. See verification field (d)

pins.name: PA23/VREF+
pins.mux: SPARE -- VREF+ (Table 6-3 'Voltage Reference' p.25) and COMP1_IN1-. Note VREF- (pin 24) is consumed by ADC_VBUS, so external-reference use of this pin is precluded; see verification field trade-off

pins.name: ADC_IU
pins.mux: A0_7 on PA22, ADC0 analog input 7 (Table 6-3 'ADC' p.17)

pins.name: ADC_IV
pins.mux: A0_3 on PA24, ADC0 analog input 3 (Table 6-3 'ADC' p.17)

pins.name: ADC_IW
pins.mux: A1_0 on PA15, ADC1 analog input 0 -- second ADC instance, see verification field (b)

pins.name: ADC_VBUS
pins.mux: A1_7 on PA21, ADC1 analog input 7; this pin is also VREF- (Table 6-3 p.25) -- see verification field trade-off

pins.name: PWM_AH

pins.name: PWM_AL

pins.name: PWM_BH

pins.name: PWM_BL

pins.name: PWM_CH
pins.mux: TIMA0_C2 [5] on PA3 (Table 6-2 p.13; Table 6-3 'Timer' p.23)

pins.name: PWM_CL
